intro.zh: 今天这批项目透露出一个清晰信号：AI 正从聊天窗口下沉到具体工作流——测试、内容生产、记忆管理、新闻筛选，都在被重新组织成可复用的技能或插件。与此同时，底层基础设施（远程桌面、代理面板、K8s 发行版）依然靠稳定和自托管赢得长期用户。创业者该关注的是那些把模型能力嵌进真实场景、而非再造一个通用入口的项目。
intro.en: Today's projects show AI moving out of the chat window and into concrete workflows: testing, content production, memory, news curation. Each is being repackaged as a reusable skill or plugin rather than another general-purpose assistant.

zh.summary: 微软开源的语音 AI 系列，最新包含流式 ASR 模型，能边说边转写「谁说了什么」，支持热词和 10 种语言；另有面向边缘 CPU 的量化推理版本，模型体积从 4.6GB 压到 1.6GB。
zh.insight: 会议记录和客服质检是最直接的落地场景：流式说话人分离省掉后处理拼接。对做端侧语音产品的团队，BitNet 版本意味着可以在无 GPU 设备上跑实时转写。

en.summary: Microsoft's open voice AI family now includes a streaming ASR model that transcribes who said what as speech arrives, with hotwords and 10 languages.
en.insight: Meeting notes and call-center QA are the obvious fits: streaming speaker separation removes post-hoc stitching.

items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: Google Research 的预训练时间序列基础模型，3.0 版本支持零样本多变量预测，已进入 BigQuery ML 和 Google Sheets。适合不想为每个数据集单独训练预测模型的团队。
zh.insight: 零售补货、能耗预测、金融指标这类场景可以直接试零样本预测。创业角度不是重做模型，而是在垂直数据上做微调和评估服务，帮企业判断什么时候基础模型够用、什么时候不够。

en.summary: Google Research's pretrained time-series foundation model. Version 3.0 supports zero-shot multivariate forecasting and is already in BigQuery ML and Sheets.
en.insight: Retail replenishment, energy forecasting, and financial metrics can try zero-shot directly. The startup angle isn't the model but fine-tuning and evaluation on…

items.description: TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model) is a pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for time-series forecasting.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 面向 Web 和移动应用的端到端测试框架，用自然语言描述目标，agent 驱动应用完成操作，再用定位器和断言校验结果。首次运行记录动作，之后无模型调用回放，应用变更才重新触发 agent。
zh.insight: 适合做 QA 外包或内部测试提效：把「写测试脚本」变成「写验收目标」，卖给没有专职自动化测试的中小团队。差异在于按需调用模型，而不是每次跑测试都烧 token。

en.summary: An end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps. You describe a goal in natural language, an agent drives the app, and locators plus assertions verify the result.
en.insight: Sell it to small teams without dedicated QA automation: turn test scripting into writing acceptance goals.

items.description: Next generation e2e testing framework for web and mobile apps.

zh.summary: 开源的 AI 代码审查 agent，支持 GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket 等平台，可接 OpenAI、Anthropic 或本地 Ollama。项目由社区维护，定位是 Qodo 商业产品的开源前身，适合想自托管审查流程的团队。
zh.insight: 适合做「代码审查合规」场景：金融、政企客户不愿把代码发给 SaaS，可基于它搭私有化审查服务。差异在于模型可换、可本地跑，数据不出内网。

en.summary: An open-source AI code review agent for GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket, with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, or local Ollama.
en.insight: Target code-review compliance: banks and government clients won't ship code to SaaS, so build a private review service on it.

items.description: 🚀 PR Agent: The Original Open-Source PR Reviewer. This project is not the Qodo free tier.

zh.summary: 为 DeepSeek Harness 做的纯插件，给 AI 加上跨会话长期记忆、待办管理、技能自我进化和多会话协同，零核心修改、零运行时依赖，安装即用、卸载即净。
zh.insight: 它说明 agent 的竞争点正从模型转向「记忆与状态管理」。如果做 agent 产品，可以把跨会话记忆做成独立层，卖给需要长期陪伴场景的工具，比如个人助理、学习教练。

en.summary: A pure plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds cross-session long-term memory, todo management, skill self-evolution, and multi-session coordination.
en.insight: It shows agent competition shifting from models to memory and state. If you build agents, offer cross-session memory as a standalone layer for long-term…

items.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来「跨会话长期记忆 + 后台自我进化」能力的纯插件实现：五轨记忆 · git 分支感知 · 回合内自我审查 · 技能自我进化与技能管理器 · 四轨待办 · COI 调度 · 会话广播 · 会话搜索 · 提示词管理器 · 临时信息便签——零核心修改、零运行时依赖，随装随用、卸载即净。

zh.summary: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 桌面应用框架，提供 75 个以上有文档的组件和原语，支持 WebAssembly、无障碍访问和 UI 集成测试，还带可选的 JavaScript 扩展运行时。目标是让 Rust 写桌面 UI 不再从零造轮子。
zh.insight: 适合做高性能桌面工具的团队，比如金融终端、编辑器、监控面板。和 Electron 方案比，内存占用和启动速度是差异点；可以围绕它做垂直行业的桌面客户端模板。

en.summary: A Rust desktop framework built on GPUI, shipping 75+ documented components and primitives, WebAssembly support, accessibility, UI integration testing,
en.insight: Aim at teams building high-performance desktop tools like trading terminals, editors, or dashboards.

items.description: Rust GUI components for building fantastic cross-platform desktop application by using GPUI.

zh.summary: 一个 LuaLaTeX 宏包，在写页面的同时用代码生成代尔夫特蓝风格的花卉页边装饰，每页由种子决定植物形态，不依赖任何外部图片。源自 Reddit 上一个排版问题的回答。
zh.insight: 这是排版工具而非创业项目，但它提示了一个方向：把生成式图形嵌进文档生产链。可以借鉴给品牌做「每份文档独一无二」的模板，比如请柬、证书、限量版印刷品。

en.summary: A LuaLaTeX package that computes Delft-blue floral page margins while the page is written, with each page's plants grown from a seed and no external images.
en.insight: This is a typesetting tool, not a startup, but it points at embedding generative graphics into document pipelines.

items.description: Procedurally generated Delft-blue floral page margins for LuaLaTeX, with plants and visitors sampled from genomes and a TikZ library that also draws them under pdfLaTeX

zh.summary: 开源自托管的远程桌面应用，定位 TeamViewer 替代品，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS，可自建中继服务器。对数据不能出境或不愿按席位付费的团队有直接吸引力。
zh.insight: 机会不在重做客户端，而在托管服务：面向中小企业的自托管远程桌面运维套餐，含中继部署、审计日志和权限管理。和 SaaS 远程桌面比，卖点是数据留在自己服务器。

en.summary: An open-source, self-hosted remote desktop app positioned as a TeamViewer alternative, covering Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS with self-hosted relay servers.
en.insight: The opportunity isn't the client but managed service: a self-hosted remote desktop ops package for SMBs, including relay deployment, audit logs,

items.description: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.

zh.summary: 一套给 AI 编码 agent 用的技能包，通过 Scenario MCP 生成生产级图片、视频、音频、纹理和 3D 资产，并能在花钱前先估价、保持角色与品牌一致；另有一组技能直接驱动 Blender、Maya、Unreal 等 DCC 软件。
zh.insight: 游戏和创意工作室是天然买家：把「资产一致性」和「预算可控」做成卖点，切独立游戏团队的美术管线。和通用文生图相比，它管的是跨资产、跨工具的一致性。

en.summary: A skill pack for AI coding agents that generates production-ready images, video, audio, textures, and 3D assets through Scenario MCP,
en.insight: Game and creative studios are the buyers: pitch consistency and budget control to indie art pipelines.

items.description: Get production-ready images, video, audio, and 3D from any AI agent: skills that pick the right model, price before spending, and keep characters and brands consistent through the Scenario MCP, plus expert teams that drive Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, and Unity.

zh.summary: 自托管的 AI 新闻雷达，从订阅源、论坛和时间线收集内容，去重、排序并生成中英双语每日简报，支持飞书、邮件、微信推送。解决信息分散、注意力有限的问题。
zh.insight: 可以做成垂直行业的「情报简报」服务：把通用新闻源换成某个细分领域（如半导体、跨境政策），按订阅收费。差异在于它输出的是带上下文和社区讨论的摘要，不是链接列表。

en.summary: A self-hosted AI news radar that collects from feeds, forums, and timelines, deduplicates and ranks items, then produces bilingual daily briefings delivered via Feishu, email,
en.insight: Turn it into a vertical intelligence briefing: swap general feeds for a niche like semiconductors or trade policy and charge a subscription.

items.description: 📡 Your own AI-powered news radar. Generates daily briefings in English & Chinese. | 用 AI 构建你专属的新闻雷达
